import re

def slugify(title):
    title = title.lower().strip()
    title = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title)
    return title

import re

def hashtags(post):
    tags = re.findall(r'#(\w+)', post)
    return tags

import re

def numbers(row):
    parts = re.findall(r'-?\d+\.\d+', row)
    return [float(p) for p in parts]

def strip_tags(html):
    html = html.strip()
    plain = re.sub('<[^>]+>', '', html)
    return plain

import os

def slug_path(base, title):
    title = title.lower().strip()
    path = os.path.join(base, title)
    return path

import json

def tags(post):
    data = json.loads(post)
    return data['tags']

import csv

def numbers(path):
    rows = csv.reader(open(path))
    return [float(r[0]) for r in rows]

def lower_all(names):
    names = sorted(names)
    plain = [n.lower() for n in names]
    return plain
